definition: Google's advertising platform for placing and measuring paid campaigns across search and other supported channels.
example: A retailer measures purchases attributed to a Google Ads search campaign.

definition: Google's former name for its conversational generative AI assistant, later rebranded as Gemini.
example: A user asks the conversational interface to draft an outline.
sense_note: Historical product name; do not assume the feature set of current Gemini products.

definition: A Google tool for managing the information an organization displays in Google Search and Maps.
example: A shop updates its public business hours and address.

definition: Google's collection of cloud computing services for building and operating applications, infrastructure, and data systems.
example: A team deploys a web service and stores application data on managed cloud resources.

definition: A discontinued Google interactive whiteboard product and associated collaboration application.

definition: Google's managed Kubernetes service for operating clusters and deploying containerized workloads.

definition: A discontinued Google website experimentation tool for testing page variations and personalization.

definition: An online spreadsheet application for organizing, calculating, analyzing, and sharing tabular data.

definition: An online presentation application for creating, editing, and sharing slide decks collaboratively.

definition: Google's suite of cloud productivity and collaboration services for organizations and individuals.

definition: A discontinued Google social networking platform for sharing posts and organizing online communities.

definition: A brand and product family best known for compact action cameras designed to record activities in motion.

definition: A tax preparation and compliance application for preparing and processing professional tax returns.

definition: Establishing and applying oversight, responsibilities, and controls for the development and use of artificial intelligence systems.

definition: Managing communication and collaboration with government officials, agencies, or public bodies on matters relevant to an organization.

definition: An open-source system for storing numeric time-series data and graphing the resulting metrics.

definition: Welcoming visitors in a way that acknowledges their arrival and provides initial orientation or assistance.

definition: Coordinating contributions and responsibilities while collaborating on a shared activity or outcome.

definition: A messaging application for creating group conversations and exchanging messages with members.

definition: An open-source software library for adding validations and checks around generative AI outputs.

definition: Performing and developing coordinated movements that require strength, balance, flexibility, and body control.
